description: The state has the primary responsibility to protect its populations from genocide, war crimes, ethnic cleansing, and crimes against humanity.
legal_function: Locates first responsibility in the territorial state.
limits: Can be invoked by abusive states rhetorically while failing in practice.

description: The international community should assist states in fulfilling protection responsibilities.
legal_function: Emphasizes prevention, capacity-building, diplomacy, and support.
limits: Often underfunded or neglected before crises escalate.

description: The international community should take timely and decisive collective action through the UN when national authorities manifestly fail.
legal_function: Links coercive responses to collective Charter processes.
limits: Does not create a general unilateral right of force.
